decision.rationale: The single successor repairs the demonstrated pairing, schema, and claim-release method defects while preserving the benchmark, retrieval, provider, gates, budget, and finite decision policy.
limitations: This is build-only evidence and does not measure product answer, citation, claim, boundary, or paired comparative quality.
The 500/100 package is a known development benchmark over open educational sources.
Literal extractive answers trade naturalness for inspectable support in this confirmation checkpoint.
Advisory reviewers are OpenAI models from one provider family and are not independent external human annotation.
No provider, paid, private-data, final 10,000-case, T1, fidelity, visual, promotion, or deployment execution occurred.
